title: Design System: Rebuttal — The Case File

components.name: Rubber Decision Stamp (Approved / Fought)
components.description: Indicates confirmed agent or merchant action on a dispute.
components.css: .ds-stamp { display: inline-block; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', Menlo, monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; border-radius: 2px; padding: 4px 10px; border: 2px solid #14713A; color: #14713A; transform: rotate(-2deg); user-select: none; }

components.name: Rubber Decision Stamp (Conceded / Lost)
components.description: Indicates conceded dispute or passed response deadline.

components.name: The Open File Sheet
components.description: White paper dossier resting directly on the desk canvas.
components.css: .ds-sheet { background-color: #FFFFFF; color: #111418; border-top: 2px solid #111418; border-radius: 0; padding: 32px; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; } .ds-sheet-title { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 14px; color: #5C6370; } .ds-sheet-amount { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 43px; font-weight: 700; margin-top: 8px; }

components.name: The Action Gate Banner
components.description: Highlighter yellow action band signaling required owner response.
components.html: Awaiting your reply by SMS · sent 14:02 to +1 ••• 4471
components.css: .ds-gate { background-color: #FFE96B; color: #111418; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 0; font-weight: 500; }

narrative.overview: Rebuttal rejects generic SaaS dashboards and synthetic gradients. A dispute is a case file, and the screen is that physical file open on the merchant's desk. The AI agent is the paralegal who investigated and assembled the evidentiary dossier overnight; the merchant is the principal who signs off. Everything on screen is evidence, a decision, or a deadline.
keyCharacteristics: Canvas and Ink: Warm paper (#FFFFFF) and desk (#EDECE6) tones with strict zero-blue palette discipline.
Evidentiary Typography: Space Grotesk narrative pairing with tabular IBM Plex Mono IDs and values.
Physical Decision Stamps: Rubber outcome stamps (FOUGHT, APPROVED, CONCEDED) replacing decorative status pills.
Aesthetic Restraint: Rules instead of cards; 0px radius everywhere except 2px on stamps; zero drop shadows, blurs, or gradients.

rules.name: The No-Blue Rule
rules.body: Zero blue permitted anywhere in the system. Links are primary ink (#111418) and underlined.

rules.name: The Chromatic Meaning Rule
rules.body: Chromatic color may only signify a human-in-the-loop gate (#FFE96B) or a verified financial outcome (#14713A, #B91C1C).

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: All monetary amounts, dates, percentages, and tracking numbers must enable tabular numerals (tabular-nums).

rules.name: The Flat-Paper Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are strictly flat. Interactive elements never lift or cast shadows on hover. Focus is designated solely by a 2px solid #111418 outline.

dos: Do keep the canvas background strictly desk #EDECE6 and the open file strictly sheet #FFFFFF.
Do use IBM Plex Mono for all amounts, timestamps, IDs, tracking numbers, and reason codes with tabular-nums.
Do keep all element radii at 0px except the decision stamp at 2px.
Do limit chromatic color strictly to highlighter #FFE96B, decision green #14713A, and decision red #B91C1C.
donts: Don't use blue anywhere in the interface (#0000FF, #2563EB, etc.). Links are ink and underlined.
Don't use cards, drop shadows, box shadows, gradients, or backdrop blur.
Don't use icons where plain words will do.
Don't use hover-lift (translateY) or page scroll animations.
